messages:
elaine: Quick sync — SOC2 readiness checklist. Need explicit owners for three items: audit-log retention/ingest, KMS/HSM rollout for key wrapping, and evidence collection for control A.3. Target for internal audit = 2025-05-15. Can owners confirm status and blockers?
omar: I can take audit-log ingest. Current status: pipeline PR open, awaiting staging infra (ticket INF-412). ETA for deploy to staging ~ 2025-03-20.
devon: assigning KMS/HSM piece to myself + eng-infra. Big blocker is HSM approvals from infra procurement. We have a tentative vendor call next Tue. If procurement stalls, fallback plan is Fedora HSM emu for testing.
jess: I'll own evidence collection for control A.3 and A.5. I have a script that pulls evidence from S3 + console logs. Need help mapping which log groups count as "audit logs" for SOC2 scope. @omar can you post the list?
omar: Posted list in #eng-logging earlier, but quick copy here: auth-service, router-proxy, inference-gateway, kms-proxy, deployment-controller. If anything else needed ping me.
patrick: FYI SRE will need a short runbook for log retention and restore test. Can we add a runbook section under docs/runbooks/compliance/audit-log-restore.md? I can draft it but need the retention window (days).
elaine: Retention policy: 365 days for prod audit logs. Put that in runbook and include steps to run a restore test quarterly.
security-bot: Automated reminder: Control evidence due 2025-04-01 for scope group alpha. See: https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2/evidence-matrix :bell:
jess: Quick question for @devon — when you do the KMS rollout, will HSM-backed keys be available in staging or only prod? Need to know for evidence capture.
devon: Plan is HSM-backed in prod only; staging will use ktd (software) keys but labelled as "non-HSM" in metadata. We'll add a tag so evidence script can filter.
omar: Re: audit-log ingest — I hit a permissions error on the staging agent. @devon any chance the service role is missing s3:GetObject on the bucket INF-logs-staging?
devon: Good catch. I just pushed a role update (terraform):
```
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "staging-logs" {
  role       = "staging-agent-role"
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
}
```
should fix once applied.
elain (typo fix): sorry, typo above — that was *elaine* :sweat_smile:
elaine: Thanks all. Action items: Omar -> audit-log ingest deploy to staging (INF-412), Devon -> procurement call + role change apply, Jess -> evidence script update to pick tagged keys/logs, Patrick -> runbook draft. Check-in next Tue. :calendar:
